description: (Na)₂InAlF₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a InAlF₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the InAlF₆ framework, In is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form InF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All In-F bond lengths are 2.53 Å. Al is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form AlF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent InF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Al-F bond lengths are 1.83 Å. F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one In and one Al atom.
